collection.title: KIA Sorento 2015 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The KIA Sorento 2015 - 2020 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Sorrento, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
